## SPIRALVISION-10 // fresh off the tape deck

| Platform | Download |
|---|---|
| Raspberry Pi (64-bit Pi OS) | `spiralvision-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` / `SpiralVision-aarch64.AppImage` |
| Linux x86_64 | `SpiralVision-x86_64.AppImage` / `spiralvision-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| Windows | `spiralvision-windows-x86_64.zip` |
| macOS (universal) | `SpiralVision-macos-universal.zip` (unsigned: right-click > Open the first time) |
| Android | `SpiralVision-android.apk` (sideload) |
| Web / PWA | https://sloev.github.io/spiralvision/ |

Desktop apps and `spiralvision-cli` need **ffmpeg** on your PATH for cameras and video files.
Linux also needs ALSA: `sudo apt install ffmpeg libasound2`.
